# Source module bundle

Pinned, unmodified GPL-3.0 source module from [guoapp-modules](https://github.com/guoapp-modules), read on 2026-11-19. `index.json` records the release tag, classification and upstream SHA-256 of `manifest.json` and `main.js`. The single indexed module `hongguo` is pinned.

The desktop uses its existing red-fruit provider and player for `hongguo`; the bundled module is retained as pinned reference material, not as a replacement playback path. Module files are source code, not site content or media.

Other previously reviewed sources were removed from this bundle on 2026-11-21 to shrink app size; a full pre-removal copy is kept outside the repository (see the dated backup folder on the Desktop).

Full license: [LICENSE](LICENSE). Upstream: [index](https://github.com/guoapp-modules/index), [runtime documentation](https://github.com/Xanerix/guoapp/blob/51f39b58bce6b4c9d464e382e86e5f79aa2e9d2b/DEVELOPMENT.md).
